The substance still stands, because the page's opening paragraph scopes the entire 90-shop list as wheat-free premises, so re-quote the preamble rather than the phrase. Do not leave a quotation mark around words the source never applied to this venue.

quote: 「当店の商品はすべて小麦・乳製品・卵不使用です」 — every product is made without wheat, dairy or egg.
found: 香米豆は、小麦・乳製品・卵 (・白砂糖) を使用しないグルテンフリーのパン屋です。当店の商品はすべて小麦・乳製品・卵不使用です。（※仕入材料の一部に白砂糖が含まれる場合がございます。）
note: Verbatim. I checked the ※ that follows — it qualifies white sugar only, not wheat, dairy or egg, so the quote is not cut before an exception that would undo it.

quote: Not applicable — bakery; no soy-sauce-based dishes served.
found: 食パン、オートミールを使ったちぎりパンや黒パン、ベーグル、フォカッチャなど季節やメニューの取り合わせを見ながら商品提供をしています。焼き菓子や冷菓は季節に合わせたお楽しみの２種類程度の販売です。
note: Correct — breads, baked sweets and chilled sweets only, plus coffee and herb tea in the eat-in corner. No savoury soy-seasoned item anywhere on the site.

quote: No dairy or egg is used anywhere in the facility, so vegan cross-contact from within the kitchen is effectively nil; sweeteners are plant-based (kibi/beet sugar, maple syrup).
found: 糖分には、ミネラルが豊富なきび砂糖や甜菜糖、メープルシロップなど、血糖値上昇の緩やかなものを使用しています。… ※当店で使うチーズは、豆乳シュレッド等の乳製品不使用のものです。
note: Both halves verbatim, and stronger than the record says — even the cheese on the savoury items is soy-based (豆乳シュレッド). vegan: full is well supported. One residual to confirm on a visit: the shop never uses the word vegan, and honey is not addressed for the rotating 焼き菓子・冷菓 line.

quote: The entire shop is purpose-built as an allergen-free (wheat/dairy/egg) bakery, so allergen avoidance is the default operating model rather than a special request.
found: 小学校の養護教諭として38年勤めるなかで、多くのアレルギーをもつ子どもと関わってきました。アレルギーのある方でも安心して、おいしいパンを食べてほしくて開店しました。
note: Under-stated by the record, if anything: the baker spent 38 years as a primary-school health teacher working with allergic children and opened the bakery specifically so allergic people could eat safely. ACCESS ALERT the record must carry: this is a one-person bakery open only on the 2nd and 4th Fri/Sat/Sun of each month, 7:30–13:30, closing when sold out, with SMS/Instagram-DM hold-orders due by 18:00 (bread) or 16:00 (everything else) the previous day.

quote: Rated ★★★★★ on the JP gluten-free guide with the note 「小麦の取り扱いなし」 (no wheat handled).
found: グルテンフリー度 ★★★★★ ポイント 小麦、乳、卵不使用の米粉パンのお店です。イートインスペースがあり、有料のコーヒーと、無料のレモン水があります。
note: The ★★★★★ rating is genuinely Kagome's. The attached note is not — same borrowed-boilerplate problem as the cross-contamination claim above. Swap in the real ポイント line, which happens to say more (no wheat, no dairy, no egg) than the phrase that was borrowed.

quote: All products are simultaneously gluten-free, dairy-free and egg-free — fully suitable for celiac and vegan diners.
found: 当店の商品はすべて小麦・乳製品・卵不使用です。
note: CITY MISASSIGNMENT — the biggest problem on this record and not a citation issue at all. 香米豆 is at 愛知県豊橋市杉山町字屋敷18, a 7-minute walk from やぐま台駅 on the 豊橋鉄道渥美線 — Toyohashi, roughly 70 km and an hour by train from Nagoya. The record files it under city: nagoya, and the cited guide itself lists it as 「／愛知・豊橋」, distinct from its 名古屋 entries at #50–52. Re-file it. On the claim itself: supported, and the venue is trading (August–November 2026 opening calendar and an August 2026 price-revision post on site).

quote: Wheat-containing 80%-rice-flour breads and the 100% rice-flour GF line are baked in the same kitchen; the komeko-palette guide notes no published contamination-prevention protocol.
found: ※ 同じ製造所内で、小麦、乳、落花生を使用した製品を作っています。 (komehanapan.wixsite.com/kobo/bread)
method: 1 plain fetch (iPhone UA); real support found by crawling the shop's own Wix page list (pageUriSEO 'bread')
note: SAFETY-CRITICAL — the claim is right but the citation actively works against it. komeko-palette says the OPPOSITE: 'The remaining 20% is made up of secondary ingredients … but does not contain wheat', and it publishes no contamination note for Komehana at all (it writes 'Contamination prevention measures' sections only for Komeko's Palette and BITTE), so 'the guide notes no published protocol' is an absence the record turned into a source statement. Worse, that article self-contradicts — it says 80%+ rice flour in one paragraph and '100% rice flour' in another — and it is content marketing published by a competing Nagoya rice-flour shop that is itself entry #1 in the same list. Do not rely on it. The shop's OWN /bread page states the risk outright, in its own words, and names a THIRD allergen the record omits entirely: 落花生 (peanuts) as well as wheat and dairy in the same production facility.

quote: The 100% rice-flour line is made without egg or dairy, but shares equipment with standard breads.
found: 米花特製の米粉を使ったスイーツです。小麦・卵・乳製品を一切使用していないのでヘルシーです。 … ※ 同じ製造所内で、小麦、乳、落花生を使用した製品を作っています。 (komehanapan.wixsite.com/kobo/bread)
method: 1 plain fetch (iPhone UA) on the cited home page, then the /bread and /about-us subpages
note: The cited URL is the Home page, which carries neither half. Both halves are on /bread. MISSING ※ EXCEPTION, and it matters to a vegan: /about-us says 「米花のパンは、卵、乳製品…を使用せず」 but immediately qualifies it 「(一部トッピングでチーズを使用しているものがあります。)」, and /bread lists ◆チーズフォカッチャ and ●クランベリーチーズ（乳○）. Egg-free yes; dairy-free only on the unmarked items. vegan: options is the right rating, but the claim text must carry the cheese exception.

quote: Pre-order system by phone/email the day before allows requesting the 100% gluten-free items; confirm separation directly.
found: パンのご注文は、受取希望日の前日午前中までに、メールgmail、またはcontactページのお問い合わせフォーム、お電話(営業時間のみ)からご連絡ください。
note: Verbatim on the cited page. Tighten one detail: the deadline is 前日午前中まで — by the MORNING of the previous day, not merely the day before. /bread adds the reason it matters: 「全て一人で作っているため、生産量に限りがあります。店頭には日替わりで下記の内、１５〜２０種類程度が並びます」 — one baker, a rotating 15–20 items from a much longer list, so the 米粉100％ item you want may simply not be baked that day unless reserved.

quote: Maintains an explicit 米粉100% gluten-free line free of wheat, egg and dairy, additive-free.
found: グルテンフリー 米粉100％パン / Gluten-free bread / 小麦を一切を使用せずに、焼き上げたモチモチ米粉パン。 (komehanapan.wixsite.com/kobo/bread)
method: 1 plain fetch (iPhone UA) on the cited home page, then /bread
note: The claim is TRUE and is a genuine positive — but the cited Home page says the opposite of it: 「米花のパンはすべて、米粉を８０％以上使用して作っています」. Repoint to /bread, which names the 米粉100％パン line explicitly (プレーン, 胡麻づくし, 塩キャラメル, マーブルチョコ, 黒糖マロン, よもぎ, 有機キャロブレーズン, スイートコーン, ナッツ&レーズンエナジーパン) and states 小麦を一切を使用せずに. 'additive-free' is carried by /about-us (保存料などを使用せず). CAFE HAZARD THE RECORD DOES NOT MENTION AT ALL: the cafe menu (komehanapan.wixsite.com/kobo/cafe-menu) sells 車麩の蒲焼き — the site's own English gloss is 'Kuruma-bu (wheel-shaped wheat gluten cakes) in teriyaki sauce' — deep-fried in oil and coated in 甘辛のタレ. That is near-pure wheat gluten plus wheat soy sauce, going through the cafe's fryer. It sits under a menu the shop describes as otherwise free of animal products, which is exactly the trap where a vegan-safe item is read as celiac-safe. The cafe's GF offer is scoped to swapping the bread (「パンを全て小麦不使用のパンに変更できます」), not to the fryer. Add this to the record as a hard warning. Trading confirmed: the site carries a current July–September night-market schedule for the 東別院暮らしの朝市 (28th of each month) and stocks the ぐうぴいひろば farmers' market in Kasugai.
